top_signals.title: Trailer Flexibility Is Becoming a Growth Strategy for Carriers
top_signals.summary:
Trailer rental for carriers is becoming a growth strategy. REPOWR’s Matt Harb explains how carriers can cut equipment costs and test new lanes without buying a trailer, and how the Trailer Optimization Platform helps fleets turn costly repositioning into revenue.

The post Trailer Flexibility Is Becoming a Growth Strategy for Carriers appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
